title: Intervals.icu Activity Fitness CTL Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=intervalsicu:activity icu_ctl=*
| stats sum(icu_ctl) as total_value, avg(icu_ctl) as avg_value by athlete_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks athlete values by total and average fitness ctl across Intervals.icu activity events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `icu_ctl` values for each Intervals.icu activity event and review total and average fitness ctl by athlete.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total fitness ctl.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly which athlete shows the biggest fitness ctl numbers in your Intervals.icu activity data.
